title: Platform systems & services — Runbook, Dashboards, Alerts, and Roadmap (Q2 2026)
author: Aisha Patel
content:
Purpose
-------
This document consolidates the platform engineering systems & services inventory, operational runbooks, key dashboards and alerting standards, recent retrospective findings, and the Q2 2026 roadmap. It is the canonical reference for oncall, incident responders, and engineers making changes to platform services.

Scope
-----
- Services covered: platform-api, router-edge, model-router, batch-processor, kv-cache, metrics-ingest, observability-ingest, dedicated-proxy, billing-rate-limiter.
- Topics: SLOs, alert thresholds, runbook playbooks (P0/P1/P2), dashboard ownership, how-tos for quick triage, and roadmap initiatives.
- Not covered: application-level business logic beyond the platform surface (see product teams' pages).

Ownership and Contacts
----------------------
- Platform Engineering (owner): eng-platform
- Oncall rotation: platform-oncall@redwood.internal
- Pager escalation: SRE Lead (Diego Morales), Platform Lead (Priya Kapoor), VP Eng (Samir Gupta)
- Slack channel: #platform-oncall

Systems & Services Inventory (high level)
-----------------------------------------
- platform-api
  - Role: HTTP façade for internal control plane and public management endpoints.
  - Owners: eng-platform/api-team
  - Primary SLOs: availability 99.95%, p95 latency < 120ms, p99 < 300ms.
- router-edge
  - Role: TLS termination, routing, auth checks and early rate limiting at edge.
  - Owners: eng-platform/networking
  - Notes: CloudFront + internal envoy fleet; use for region-based routing.
- model-router
  - Role: routes inference requests between runtime pools (hosted/dedicated/private).
  - Owners: eng-serving-runtime
- batch-processor
  - Role: asynchronous batching for background jobs and embeddings ingestion.
  - Owners: eng-platform/batch
  - Capacity target: 5k requests/s sustained per region.
- kv-cache
  - Role: prefix and KV cache for inference state; Redis cluster with replicas.
  - Owners: eng-platform/cache
- metrics-ingest
  - Role: Prometheus remote_write endpoint + preprocessor for metrics.
  - Owners: eng-platform/observability
- observability-ingest
  - Role: Traces and spans collector (OTel), logs aggregator (Loki)
  - Owners: eng-platform/observability
- dedicated-proxy
  - Role: reserved capacity entrypoint for Dedicated customers.
  - Owners: eng-platform/dedicated
- billing-rate-limiter
  - Role: applies usage quotas, prevents overcharge, enforces rate limits.
  - Owners: finance-infra

Key SLOs, SLIs and Alerting thresholds
---------------------------------------
Summary of canonical SLOs (owner must keep dashboards aligned):
- platform-api: availability >= 99.95% (30d); p99 latency < 300ms (5m window)
- router-edge: availability >= 99.99% (30d); TLS handshake errors < 0.01% of handshakes
- model-router: successful route rate >= 99.9% (30d)
- kv-cache: cache-hit-rate >= 85% for hot prefixes
- batch-processor: job-failure-rate < 0.5% and queue-latency p95 < 60s

Alerting rules (standardized)
- Severity: P0 | P1 | P2 mapping
  - P0: immediate pager — service down, SLO drop > 5% sustained 15m, data loss
  - P1: pager during business hours or Slack during off-hours — degraded performance (p99 latency > threshold for 10m), error rate > 2% for 5m
  - P2: ticket + channel notification — single-region partial degradation, non-critical throttling

Representative Prometheus alert rules (short)
- platform_api_high_latency_p1: expr: histograms_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(platform_api_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.5
- platform_api_error_rate_p1: expr: sum(rate(platform_api_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(platform_api_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02
- kv_cache_low_hit_rate_p2: expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m])) < 0.7

Dashboards (owner and key panels)
---------------------------------
- Platform Overview (owner: eng-platform/observability)
  - Panels: global 5m p50/p95/p99 latency for platform-api, request rate by route, error rate heatmap, active connections
- Edge & Routing (owner: eng-platform/networking)
  - Panels: TLS errors, route distribution by model variant, downstream latency
- Cache Health (owner: eng-platform/cache)
  - Panels: hit/miss ratio, eviction rate, per-prefix latency, top keys by size
- Batch Jobs (owner: eng-platform/batch)
  - Panels: queue depth, job throughput, failure types, worker CPU/memory
- Observability Ingest (owner: eng-platform/observability)
  - Panels: Prometheus remote_write backlog, OTel spans/s, Loki ingestion rate, storage utilization

Runbooks (P0: Service Down example - platform-api)
--------------------------------------------------
1) Detection
   - Pager triggers: P0 alert fired (availability < 99%), or PagerDuty incident created by monitoring.
   - Triage channel: post incident to #platform-oncall, include alertname and Grafana link.
2) Initial Triage (first 5 minutes)
   - Check global Platform Overview dashboard.
   - Confirm: is the issue regional or global? Check cluster / region dropdowns.
   - Run quick checks:
     - kubectl get pods -n platform | grep platform-api
     - curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://platform-api.internal/health
   - If control plane unreachable, escalate immediately to SRE Lead.
3) Mitigation actions (choose applicable)
   - If pods are CrashLooping:
     - kubectl describe pod <pod> -n platform
     - kubectl logs <pod> -n platform --previous
     - Roll back recent deploy: kubectl rollout undo deployment/platform-api -n platform
   - If high latency due to downstream kv-cache miss storms:
     - Temporarily enable cache-bypass for non-critical routes (config flag: PLATFORM_CACHE_BYPASS=true)
     - Scale cache replica count: terraform apply (see infra playbook) or increase replica count via k8s HPA.
   - If overloaded: enable emergency autoscaling (manual scale of replicas to +50%) and add temporary rate-limiting at router-edge.
4) Recovery and Post-incident
   - Declare service recovered when alerts clear for 20m and p99 within SLO bounds.
   - Create postmortem in /confluence/eng-platform/postmortems with timeline, root cause, action items.

How-tos (common operational tasks)
----------------------------------
- Adding a new dashboard
  1. Create dashboard JSON from Grafana UI.
  2. Store JSON in git repo: infra/observability/grafana/dashboards.
  3. Open PR targeting main; include owner and an example panel screenshot.
  4. After merge, apply via CI (flux/terraform) and verify in staging.
- Creating an alert rule
  1. Author Prometheus rule under monitoring/alerts/<team>.rules.yml
  2. Include rationale, severity, runbook link, and test queries.
  3. Open PR and request reviewers from eng-platform/observability and the owning service.
- Oncall handover checklist
  - Update channel with ongoing incidents and mitigation state.
  - Confirm all active alerts acknowledged and actioned or transferred.
  - Update rotation calendar with personal notes.

Retrospective highlights (last 3 quarters)
------------------------------------------
- Incident: KV cache eviction storm (2025-11-03)
  - Root cause: sudden model rollout with memory-heavy key patterns.
  - Actions: increased default maxmemory-policy buffer, introduced per-prefix size-based LRU, added pre-rolling cache-warm for model rollouts.
- Incident: Observability ingest backlog (2025-12-14)
  - Root cause: misconfigured retention and an errant spike from a downstream client.
  - Actions: added leaky-bucket rate limit at metrics-ingest, alert for remote_write backlog > 5m, and a per-client quota system.

Roadmap (Q2 2026 priorities)
----------------------------
- Delivery themes
  1. Observability + Cost: reduce monitoring ingestion cost by 20% via sampling and pre-aggregation (owner: eng-platform/observability)
  2. Resilience: regional failover automation for model-router and dedicated-proxy (owner: eng-serving-runtime)
  3. Developer experience: self-serve dashboard creation with templates and tests (owner: eng-platform/devexp)
  4. Cost controls: implement dynamic batching recommendations surfaced to customers via Redwood Console (owner: eng-platform/optimize)
- Milestones
  - 2026-04-15: rollout sampling pilot for metrics-ingest (staging).
  - 2026-05-12: automated regional failover alpha for model-router.
  - 2026-06-30: dashboard self-serve v1 shipped.

Appendix: Example alert rule (YAML)
----------------------------------
# platform_api_error_rate_p1
groups:
- name: platform-api.rules
  rules:
  - alert: PlatformAPIHighErrorRate_P1
    expr: |
      sum(rate(platform_api_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(platform_api_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: P1
      team: eng-platform
    annotations:
      summary: "Platform API error rate > 2% (5m)"
      runbook: "/confluence/eng-platform/platform-systems-and-services-runbook-and-roadmap-q2-2026"

Appendix: Common CLI snippets
----------------------------
- kubectl rollout status deployment/platform-api -n platform
- kubectl get hpa -n platform
- curl -sS -H 'Host: platform-api.internal' https://router-edge.internal/status

Action items (owners)
---------------------
- eng-platform/observability: implement sampling pilot by 2026-04-15.
- eng-serving-runtime: delivery of regional failover alpha by 2026-05-12.
- eng-platform/devexp: create dashboard templates and docs by 2026-06-30.

If you make a change to alerts or dashboards referenced here, update this page and notify the reviewers list.
